ns2:section.sectionText: Students will explore sustainability and design as well as leadership in a global context through course materials and project work. During the semester students will participate in a global classroom that will guide them in future project work. Students will then travel to Guatemala during spring break, March 11-18, to work with Guatemalan students at the Universidad de Valle on a Human centered design project with local community members. Enrollment in this section does not include travel costs, which must be paid separately. This course is restricted to ARISE and MEP students.
